title: Example 133: a refill capped by the room left, proved equal to the capped sum by the tool's own checker within the precondition
description: Regression proof of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.ratelimit.TokenBucket#tokensAfter by the tool's own bounded model checker (--engine native) within the module's precondition as scope: Math.min(capacity, tokens + earned) rewritten as tokens + Math.min(earned, capacity - tokens). Expected verified, nine paths and ten solver calls in about half a second inline; without the scope the versions differ where the sum overflows a long.
